quest.title: A Commission From the Curatorium of Secrets
quest.description: Out of the blue, you receive a letter from the Curatorium of Secrets. Nefer seems to have a commission that only you can handle...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2

chapter.num: Where Waves Meet the Reef: Part I
chapter.title: A Commission From the Curatorium of Secrets

talks.objective: Read the letter from the Curatorium of Secrets

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello? Anyone here?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Ah, you got here even earlier than I expected. That should give us just enough time to go over some details before the opening ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what did you need us to do?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: How about a cup of tea first? I'm sure it was a long trip.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: #Now tell me, {NICKNAME} and Paimon... Have you heard of the "Nod-Krai Trade Expo"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, nope...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: A long time ago, back before Nasha Town even had that name, this place was essentially one giant black market.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: With no administrative oversight, trade that was prohibited elsewhere was fair game here. So, this place began to attract business from all over Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Over time, more and more people settled here, and what was once a black market became what is now Nasha Town.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: The spirit of free trade has been a local staple ever since. Hence, the "Nod-Krai Trade Expo" was born.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... is it like a business convention?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: In a sense. It's an annual tradition once the shipping routes open up. The expo offers a chance to trade without restrictions.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: In other words, it's the biggest "legal" black market in all of Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, is that why you asked me to come?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Yes. The Voynich Guild is organizing the event, and that comes with a lot of responsibilities.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Normally, I would let Jahoda handle most of the work. But this year, it might prove too much for her to manage on her own.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Something tells me we'll have a lot of big names in attendance this time. Working with VIP clients takes someone with the right experience and connections.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Hence why I think Jahoda might need a helping hand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, so that's where {NICKNAME} comes in!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Exactly. I was hoping you could help her with participant coordination.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's nice of you to look out for Jahoda.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I don't know if I'd put it quite like that. I'm just interested in playing to people's strengths.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: In addition, I think you'll find the compensation to be quite to your satisfaction. So, are you in?

choices.text: Yeah, should be a piece of cake.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Confident, I like it. This is exactly why I chose everyone's favorite globe-trotting hero for this job.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: I do have one special request, as the one offering this commission.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: In principle, the Nod-Krai Trade Expo is a platform for commerce with no restrictions. That said, the Guild does have one line that is not to be crossed.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: I'll need you to help make sure all participants are clear on this unspoken rule. As long as everyone complies, the expo should go off without a hitch.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So what's the unspoken rule?

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: No violence at the expo. The Guild has pledged to ensure the safety of all sellers and buyers in attendance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Violence? Whoa, that wasn't even on Paimon's radar... Just because it's legal doesn't change the fact that this is still a black market, huh...

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: If that line is crossed, the event will descend into chaos.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Understood.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Of course, mediating such situations might prove complicated. So, if you ever want my judgment on the matter, just come find me.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: The expo is being held on the shoreline to the southeast of Nasha Town. Jahoda is working on setting up the booths as we speak. She'll be able to provide details on the participants as well.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Alright, I suppose I'll leave you to it, then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, we've got this!

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Hah, good instincts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is where Nefer said the expo should be...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Lemme think... Yeah, let's go with this! We can't keep changing the setup.

dialogues.speaker: Wislawa
dialogues.text: Where are the goods being stored? You still haven't told us.

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: And what's the Guild's cut on transactions this year?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Sorry, um, one question at a time please...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Shoulda just stuck to cat wrangling...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Jahoda.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? Sorry, I've got kind of a line here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry. We're not here to pile more work on you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nefer asked us to help you out.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Really? Ah, Boss Nef, you absolute lifesaver! I'm seriously drowning over here! You two are doing me a huge favor...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nefer asked us to handle participant coordination. So, how can we help?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ooh, lemme think... Oh, right! There are still three participants that haven't checked in...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (At least, I think it was three...? C'mon, Jahoda, get a grip. I'm not forgetting anything... am I?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Jahoda's doing her freaking-out face again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't panic. We're on your team.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Sorry, there's just so much to keep track of...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's start with the basics, then. What does "participant coordination" involve, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's things like... registering all the participants, verifying their goods, showing them to their booths...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh, and if any disputes break out between them, it's your job to mediate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: We're still waiting on the sellers for these last three booths. One's reserved for Aino, but as for the other two...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: They're both big-deal clients from abroad. The kind of people we really don't want to offend. So be extra careful around them, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}'s got this. What's the worst that could happen?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You don't get it... One of them's the captain of some mercenary fleet sailin' the high seas, and the other's a top dog in the criminal underworld. Getting on their bad side's one-hundred-percent a no-go...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If something goes wrong — let's hope that's a big if — don't engage. Just tell 'em you work for Boss Nef.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright. You have a bunch of work still, right? Leave the merc captain and gangster boss to us!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ah, lifesavers, the both of you! Nod-Krai Hot Dogs are on me later, I promise! And whatever else you want!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm guessing the two sellers I just mentioned are caught up with lodging or cargo. You should be able to find them at these addresses.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'd get over there pronto if I were you. People like that don't take well to be kept waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh, and tell Aino to bust a move, would you? The booth I'm saving for her is in a prime location. If she doesn't come claim it, the other participants are gonna start asking questions.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: If you find yourself in a tricky situation, just come find me.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: One at a time...

talks.objective: Let Jahoda know that the exhibition participants are all here

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: Hey, what was that for!?

dialogues.speaker: Punk
dialogues.text: Just shut up and move along. This spot is mine now!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ahem...!

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: It's the lady in charge... We were just setting up our booth, and he's trying to take it from us!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hm, a troublemaker, huh... The expo announcement spells it out clear as day: "All forms of violence are strictly prohibited." Read it and weep, buster!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (I've been wanting to talk tough like that for ages! Should be enough to scare off a punk like him, no problem.)

dialogues.speaker: Punk
dialogues.text: Hmph... It's not like I wanted to hit anyone... It's just not fair.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: What's that supposed to mean?

dialogues.speaker: Punk
dialogues.text: We all know the black market stuff is in the highest demand here, so how did these twerps get a spot selling these stupid toys?

dialogues.speaker: Punk
dialogues.text: I did some digging, and guess what? Turns out these brats have connections in the Voynich Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Punk
dialogues.text: Obviously, someone pulled a few strings to get them here. But me? I miss one stupid deadline, and that's when the rules start to matter? Give me a break.

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: Hey, we earned our place fair and square!

dialogues.speaker: Punk
dialogues.text: Tch, as if...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: So you're singling out the easy targets, huh? That might work for you on the outside, but not here, and not under my watch!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: These kids earned the right to be here same as everyone else. Don't believe me, take it up with the Guild. We'll see who comes out on top.

dialogues.speaker: Punk
dialogues.text: ...Hmph, just you wait.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who the heck was that?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Just some punk looking for a fight. Heh, but I scared him off without even lifting a finger.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Phew... I'm still shaking. That was close, almost had to pull the Nefer card.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, he's lucky he decided to run off, or we'd have helped teach him a lesson!

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: Thanks a million, miss!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: All in a day's work. Anyway, knew I remembered you guys. Your guardian works for the Guild, right? Who was it again...?

dialogues.speaker: Ashvapati
dialogues.text: Ati! Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: I'm fine, just got a little scrape when he pushed me.

dialogues.speaker: Ashvapati
dialogues.text: I got caught up with something. I should have been here, I'm sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ah, right! Ashvapati! The one man in the Guild who wouldn't know profit if it hit him in the face.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You get a spot in the most lucrative market in the world, and you're letting the kids use it to sell... toys? No one else would even entertain that idea.

dialogues.speaker: Ashvapati
dialogues.text: Well, the purpose of the expo is free trade, right? There's no rule that participants have to sell weapons.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: No, but... most people know what's gonna make real dough. Unlike a certain someone.

dialogues.speaker: Ashvapati
dialogues.text: Ati, Neb, Raya, head back to the booth. If anything else comes up, you call for me, okay? Don't be reckless.

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: Okay, got it...

choices.text: The technology used to make these toys...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah...

response.speaker: Ashvapati
response.text: Heh... You two know your stuff.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Wait, what? Then why not make them look the part? They'll sell tons better that way.

response.speaker: Ashvapati
response.text: ...If you were to leave your kids a gift, would you choose a toy, or a weapon?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Well...

response.speaker: Ashvapati
response.text: In any case, I'm not looking to make it big. I applied for the expo because the kids thought it would be fun. All I care about is them having a good time.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Fair enough... You're still gonna be busy with Guild business though, right? Just a heads up, this might not be the safest place to leave the kids unattended...

response.speaker: Ashvapati
response.text: I understand... A lot of children suffer because their parents are too consumed with work. It's unavoidable sometimes, but I want them to have better...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: ...You know what? Don't even sweat it. I'll look out for them.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (What the heck are you doing, Jahoda?)

response.speaker: Ashvapati
response.text: Really? That would be amazing! What do you say to Miss Jahoda, you three?

response.speaker: Ati & Neb & Raya
response.text: Thank you, Miss Jahoda!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: My pleasure, hehe... Just have them come find me if anything comes up.

response.speaker: Ashvapati
response.text: Got it. I should get going, then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, way to step up, Jahoda!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: I'm just looking out for some kids. How hard could it be? Then again, I bet I'll be swamped with disputes to settle once this thing gets rolling for real... *sigh*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Relax, we'll help you out! Oh, also, we registered the last three participants. So, the expo can start now, right?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Wow, already? In that case, lemme go get things ready for the grand opening! Talk to ya later!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She really does have a lot on her shoulders...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, we should help as much as we can.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Ahem! Attention everyone! Participant registration is now complete. On behalf of the Voynich Guild, I am pleased to announce that the Nod-Krai Trade Expo is open for business!

choices.text: Perhaps it can also be used to make weapons?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wonder how Beidou, Navia, and Ineffa's goods are selling? Let's go check!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Excuse me, according to the expo announcement, you are in charge of mediating disputes between participants, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Just now, as Aino was about to return to the workshop, she got dragged into a conversation with some individuals who appear to have unofficial ties to the expo.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: My database does not have relevant information on how to address this situation, so I came to you for help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Unofficial ties, huh? Sounds a little shady...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Come with me.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: A device that uses pneuma and ousia energies in battle... With that kind of tech, a bandit group could rob a caravan without even showing their faces.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: And what about this thing... Remote guidance, precision bombing at long-distance... If a group of thugs got their hands on it, their enemies might as well surrender on the spot.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The Fontaine Research Institute made the right call going through the Spina di Rosula rather than selling it themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: The same is true for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, I'm sure. A merc captain who spends most of her time at sea is far less conspicuous.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: What about this girl? She seems to be trading in military-grade weapons as well...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: The Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop does take on a lot of orders for dangerous creations, but I think in this case...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'm overthinking it?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I think so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yelan? Chevreuse? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? How did you find this place?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Although this location is indeed rather secluded, Aino has equipped me with a special sensor module. With it, I was able to detect that you had pulled her aside for questioning.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: The rumors are true, then... She's quite the little engineer.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Can you tell me what this is about already?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Apologies, but it's a matter of utmost importance, so I had to be sure. After our conversation, however, I can confirm that Aino is not involved in this case.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, could you help us clear up this misunderstanding?

choices.text: Ineffa, why don't you get Aino out of here?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Understood.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Based on our conversation just now, I'm guessing neither of us is the target the other is searching for.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I second that. And, since our strategies were so similar, I'd wager we're after the same person.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Paimon thought so too!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Well, I wasn't planning on dragging you into all this, but now that I appear to have gained an unexpected partner, I suppose I might as well explain...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: #I trust you, {NICKNAME}, and Miss Chevreuse seems to do the same. With you here, I'm hoping we can avoid further misunderstandings.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Hmm... Agreed.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm all ears.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Miss Chevreuse and I seem to be here in Nod-Krai to reel in the same fish.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: That's right, and the product we brought to trade is the bait. Of course, if I worked the booth, it might tip people off, so that's where Navia comes in. I assume it's the same situation with Captain Beidou?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, does that mean your target is gonna be at the expo?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Yes. There's a good chance it's one of the buyers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, um... What about Nefer's golden rule?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: What? No. I've done some digging into the head of the Curatorium and where she stands. We can't let her know what we're doing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: #Heh... I wouldn't be surprised if she got {NICKNAME} involved because she anticipated this from the start.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: #If {NICKNAME} has someone to answer to, then we should go.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Hmm... Fine.

choices.text: We're gonna need to take you to the Curatorium.
It seemed like you both were hiding something.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nefer? You here? Turns out, we actually do need your help with something...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Ah, Miss Yelan from Liyue and Miss Chevreuse from Fontaine. It's quite the honor. Forgive me for not greeting you sooner.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: So you knew we were coming all along...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Anticipating your arrival is one thing. Getting you to come talk to me is another.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #And that's why you put {NICKNAME} in charge of participant coordination.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #You knew we trusted {M#him}{F#her} enough to tell {M#him}{F#her} the truth about our plans.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #And you also knew that, out of respect for your arrangement, the first thing {M#he}{F#she} would do... is bring us here.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: How else could I have gotten us all to the negotiating table?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So this was the plan all along...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: #Forgive me for not clueing you in, {NICKNAME}. I had a feeling things could get complicated, so caution was vital.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Rest assured, you will still be compensated as promised.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, uh, can someone explain what's going on here?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Yes, might as well get it out in the open, ladies. You two were going to exchange intel sooner or later, correct? No better time than the present.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: ...Recently, the bandits at our border have become more aggressive. We don't know how, but they seem to have gotten their hands on some kind of weapon, which has made them a lot more dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The caravan transports have been helpless against their attacks.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: We're facing a similar situation in Fontaine. Conflicts between gangs have been escalating, with civilians getting caught in the crossfire.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Our investigation indicates that someone has been supplying the gangs with some unusually powerful weaponry. Even with the Spina's help, we've been struggling to curb the fighting.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: In which case, I think we can confirm that we're facing arms dealers operating on an international scale.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Yes, and their cover has been ironclad. There hasn't been so much as a trace leading back to them... until their most recent operation.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Let me guess... Someone leaked where the weapons are coming from? And it pointed right to the Nod-Krai Trade Expo?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Exactly.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I see... Well, weapons tend to be a hot commodity in a market with no restrictions.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Say that the person you're searching for is in attendance... Does that mean you're prepared to ruin the expo to nab them?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I won't lie to you, catching this person is my top priority.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: How about this? In the spirit of being a good host, you give us a bit of leeway to do what's necessary, and in return, we won't do anything to undermine the expo.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: All deals made at the expo are protected, including those that would be illegal elsewhere. It's the entire purpose of an event like this.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: The Voynich Guild gets a cut from both the seller and the buyer, so we have a duty to uphold that principle.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I can't just let a customer get scooped up by the authorities while everyone watches.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You said this was a negotiation, but you don't seem prepared to compromise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's think about this... Maybe there's another way?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: ...Only deals made through the expo are protected, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: ...Theoretically speaking, were any deals to take place outside of the expo's scope, I would have no right to interfere.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Good. Then we can promise that the rules will be followed.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: #I want insurance, then. To hold you to your word, {NICKNAME} must be part of all operations related to the investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: We have a deal.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Then, you have my thanks in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like negotiations were a success!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: #It's the best outcome I could have asked for. I appreciate the help, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: In that case, do me one more favor, would you? When this is all over, I want to hear the real story behind everything that goes down.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No problem.

choices.text: I didn't want there to be conflict between you guys, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: When this is all over, I want to hear the real story behind everything that goes down.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Looks like we'll be working together quite closely. The pleasure is all mine, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: This whole negotiation really feels like something out of a light novel...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, there are sooo many people here now that the expo's officially underway!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shall we take a look around? Or maybe check in on our friends first?
